collection.title: Aston Martin Cygnet 2011 to 2013 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: The Aston Martin Cygnet 2011 - 2013 model requires a 21" wiper blade on the drivers side and an 18" blade on the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Hook type arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm, there is also the option of upgrading to the newer Retrofit style wiper blade. We also offer a choice of rear screen wipers for this Cygnet which can be viewed by clicking on the Rear Screen Wiper Blade tab below.
